# Reproducibility {#sec-reproducibility}



## Data provenance

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Source | [GEO GSE226609](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE226609) |
| File | `GSE226609_rsem_count.txt.gz` (RSEM expected counts, gene symbols) |
| Organism / tissue | *Mus musculus*, C57BL/6 female, whole lung |
| Library | Stranded poly-A mRNA, Illumina HiSeq 4000 |
| Upstream processing (by depositors) | Bowtie2 v2.1.0 to the UCSC transcript set, RSEM v1.2.15 |
| Groups | WT saline, WT HDM, ALOX15 KO saline, ALOX15 KO HDM (n = 5 each) |

: Dataset used in this book {#tbl-provenance}

## Outputs

Each chapter writes its figures to `figures/` and its result tables to `tables/` when the book is rendered:

- `tables/DE_<contrast>.csv`: full edgeR results for each of the five contrasts
- `tables/kegg_ora_HDM_in_WT.csv`, `tables/kegg_gsea_HDM_in_WT.csv`: KEGG enrichment results
- `tables/genes_by_mechanism.csv`: HDM-induced genes grouped into mechanism themes
